 Saint Thomas Tommies play the Green Bay Phoenix in non-conference play 
 St. Thomas faces Green Bay in out-of-conference play 
 1:57 By The Associated Press November 8, 2026, 4:43 AM Share Follow ABC News on Google Green Bay Phoenix (1-1) at Saint Thomas Tommies (1-1)
 Sunday, 2 p.m. EST
 BOTTOM LINE: St. Thomas takes on Green Bay in a non-conference matchup.
 St. Thomas went 14-1 at home last season while going 24-10 overall. The Tommies shot 50.6% from the field and 36.1% from 3-point range last season.
